title: FluentDB
claim: Product Hunt: FluentDB — The AI database client for Mac
why_good: An AI-native database client for Mac — query and explore DBs in natural language, a real productivity win for devs and analysts.
value: Prosumer/team subscription like TablePlus + AI; devs already pay for good DB clients.
risk: TablePlus, DataGrip and every DB tool are adding AI; the AI layer must be clearly better to justify switching.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: FluentDB —— Mac 上的 AI 数据库客户端。
zh.why_good: 一个 AI 原生的 Mac 数据库客户端——用自然语言查询和探索数据库,对开发者和分析师是真实的效率提升。
zh.value: 像 TablePlus + AI 那样收专业/团队订阅;开发者本就为好用的 DB 客户端付费。
